brief:
Israeli Defense Minister Yisrael Katz intends to sign a military order on Sunday banning all flights of fiber-optic and SIM-card-equipped drones in Israeli airspace, the Maan Wire reported. The directive aims to counter evolving technological threats.

The move represents an effort to restrict unmanned aerial vehicles that operate through fiber-optic cables or cellular communication systems, which officials view as posing security risks within Israeli territory.
dek: Israeli Defense Minister Yisrael Katz intends to sign a military order on Sunday banning all flights of fiber-optic and SIM-card-equipped drones in Israeli airspace, the Maan Wire reported.
title: Israel's defense minister to ban fiber-optic drones from airspace
